constraints.title: Qualified nosemgrep does not suppress — use a bare // nosemgrep

detector.message: qualified 'nosemgrep: <rule>' does NOT suppress semgrep — only a bare '// nosemgrep' does (go.md). Remove the ': <rule>'.

constraints.title: shellcheck disable inline '-- comment' is invalid — put it on a separate line

detector.message: a 'shellcheck disable=<codes> -- comment' INLINE is invalid — the '--' comment must be on a SEPARATE line (go.md/shellcheck).
